ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT "Agreement"), made as of the 23rd day of April, 2026, by and between 1342 INWOOD LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 670 Myrtle Avenue, Suite 243, Brooklyn, New York 11205 (at times referred to herein as “1342 Inwood"), and 1351 JEROME HOLDINGS LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 670 Myrtle Avenue #243, Brooklyn, New York 11205 (at times referred to herein as “1351 Jerome"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, 1342 Inwood is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Bronx and County of Bronx, City and State of New York, generally known as and by the street address 1342 Inwood Avenue, Bronx, New York, and (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein referred to as the “Parcel A Land,"” said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein referred to as the “Parcel A Building,”and the Parcel A Land and the Parcel A Building being herein collectively referred to as “Parcel A.” and the owner of Parcel A, and its successors and assigns, shall be referred to herein at times collectively as"ParcelAOwner"); WHEREAS, 1351 Jerome is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Bronx and County of Bronx, City and State of New York, generally known as and by the street address 1351 Jerome Avenue,Bronx, New York, and designated as Tax Lot 141 in Block 2856 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit “B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein collectively referred to as the “Parcel B Land,” said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein referred to as the “Parcel B Building,"” and the Parcel B Land, the Parcel B Building being herein collectively referred to as “Parcel B", and the owner of Parcel B, and its successors and assigns, shall be referred to herein at times as “Parcel B Owner", and at times Parcel A Owner and Parcel B Owner are referred to herein individually as a *Party" or collectively, as the “Parties"); WHEREAS, Parcel B Owner intends to demolish the Parcel B Building and construct a new building (said new building and any Rebuilding or replacements thereof, at times hereinafter referred to as the “New Developer Building") on Parcel B with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Parcel B under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if Parcel B were to be considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to Parcel A, if Parcel A were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot, that are in excess of the Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), which are availablefor transferpursuant to theZoningResolution;
